worksheet.title: Sourcing Model Worksheet
worksheet.description: Choose how you will source and sell your products, and capture the reasoning behind your choice.

fields.label: Your sourcing model
fields.helpText: Choose the model that fits where you are right now. You can move to a different model later.

fields.label: Why this model fits your situation
fields.helpText: There are no wrong answers. 'Because I can start quickly and learn as I go' is a perfectly good reason.

fields.label: Estimated startup cost
fields.helpText: A rough estimate of what you expect to spend before your first listing is live. Include samples, tools, and any upfront inventory.

fields.label: Timeline to first listing
fields.helpText: How long do you expect it to take to have your first product listed for sale? Example: '2 weeks' or '6–8 weeks'.
